products.excludeReason: Sacombank does not publish an interest rate for this product (the product page only says 'Lãi suất cạnh tranh'). The app listing, T&C, the on-site calculator and the fee schedule contain no rate or worked example, so the cost cannot be calculated.
products.notes: Best fit for salaried workers, but no rate is published in any official source we could read. Searched (2026-11-03): Vietnamese and English product pages, T&C DKDK_VTCTL (12/09/2024, no rate), App Store listing for SACOMBANK PAY (no rate; Google Play page could not be loaded), the base-rate table, the rate/fee tools on the site, the Combo Đại Lộc page, the fee schedule. The Vietnamese product page exists (earlier guessed paths were wrong). Early repayment is free online per the fee schedule effective 09/04/2026, but a 2% commitment fee (100k-300k VND) applies under the same schedule. A '9,6%/năm' figure from a secondary site has no support in any official source and is not recorded.

percent.note: General schedule I.1.a (counter, declining-balance loans): medium/long-term từ 3% in years 1-2, từ 2% from year 3; minimum 200.000 đồng; before VAT. 'Từ' means at least. fees.nameVi: Phí trả nợ trước hạn (khoản vay tính lãi trên dư nợ ban đầu)

timing.note: Fee schedule I.3.b (effective 09/04/2026): on early settlement, collect the full interest of the settlement period, then charge a fee equal to the difference between interest on the original balance and interest on the declining balance; where the contract names a specific fee, the contract applies. The schedule gives its own conversion formula L = 2n x a / (n + 1) (L: declining-balance rate %/year; n: loan months; a: original-balance rate %/year).

percent.note: Not a fixed percentage: see the timing note.

Hints, not proof: (1) the live product page points its 'Lãi suất' and 'Biểu phí' sections to the rate sheet, while the FAQ is only under 'Câu hỏi thường gặp'; (2) PDF metadata: the rate sheet was created 2026-01-30 and still carries the old bank name 'Sài Gòn Thương Tín', while the FAQ was created 2023-06-28 and modified 2026-06-04 together with two sibling PDFs within 12 minutes (looks like a batch edit, possibly the bank rename); (3) the 2025 promotion sits a steady 0.2 points under the rate sheet. researchNotes: 1) Licence: 'sacombank' is on data/licensed-institutions.json; legal name Ngân hàng TMCP Sài Gòn Tài Lộc (formerly Sài Gòn Thương Tín; a news report says the SBV approved the rename on 01/06/2026, not checked at an official source). 2) Vietnamese product pages FOUND on 2026-11-03: /ca-nhan/vay/vay-tieu-dung/vay-tin-chap-tu-luong.html, .../vay-tieu-dung-tu-luong.html, .../thau-chi-tieu-dung.html, and /ca-nhan/the/dich-vu-the/vay-tieu-dung-tren-sacombank-pay.html. 3) Main finding: Sacombank does NOT publish an offered rate for the salary loans (online or branch) or the consumption overdraft; the pages say only 'Lãi suất cạnh tranh'. Searched: Vietnamese and English product pages; T&C DKDK_VTCTL (12/09/2024, no rate); App Store listing for SACOMBANK PAY (no rate; Google Play could not be loaded); the on-site loan calculator (the rate box is typed by the user, sample 8%/8.5% are placeholders); the rate tool (only the base-rate table effective 26/05/2026: 6,5%-8,2%/năm short term, 10,0% mid/long term other purposes, 10,5% real estate); the Combo Đại Lộc page (salary of 25 triệu/month or more through Sacombank gets a 'preferential rate on salary-based unsecured loans', no figure; its '0,15%' is a savings bonus); the fee schedule; the March 2026 average-lending-rate notice (an image, not a product rate). 4) The '9,6%/năm' (0,8%/tháng) figure from a secondary site has no support in any official source and is not recorded; another aggregator's 8,5%/năm (2023) is equally unverified. 5) Card-holder loan: the rate sheet (1.2% / 1.5%) and the FAQ (1.5% / 1.4%) still disagree and neither is dated. The live product page points its rate and fee sections to the rate sheet, and advertises 'từ 1%/tháng'. PDF metadata hints (not proof): rate sheet created 2026-01-30 with the old bank name; FAQ created 2023-06-28 and modified 2026-06-04 with two sibling PDFs within 12 minutes; the expired 2025 promotion (12% / 15.6% per year) sits 0.2 points under the rate sheet. These lean to the rate sheet but do not settle it. 6) Fee schedule effective 09/04/2026 (phi-tin-dung.pdf, file last modified 2026-05-12): online salary loan early repayment free; 2% commitment fee (100k-300k) on that loan; late interest 10%/năm; counter loans early repayment from 3% (years 1-2), from 2% (year 3 on), minimum 200.000; original-balance (flat) loans pay the difference between the two interest methods, using the bank's formula L = 2n x a / (n + 1). 7) Conflicts: online salary loan max 50 triệu (product page) vs 100 triệu (T&C 12/09/2024); card-holder loan 100 triệu per loan (documents) vs 400 triệu total (Vietnamese page). 8) Surprising: the 2% commitment fee on the online salary loan is not on the product page; the counter salary loan 'gives' 'An Tâm Tín Dụng' insurance with no terms found; the consumption overdraft is unsecured per the Vietnamese page; the salary-loan calculator's sample result matches no standard calculation. Time-limited promotions (from 7,5%/năm, 40.000 tỷ) are not recorded.
